name: Feed Match
office_task: Every morning, match each bank-feed payment to the bill in Xero it paid, by the bill id, and put every one that does not clearly match in front of the bookkeeper.
systems_of_record: Xero (the ledger that issues the bill_id and records each bill's payment)
the business's bank feed into Xero (statement lines carrying the bill_id in the payment reference)

emits.write: the run's reconciliation report, written where the bookkeeper opens it: the pair contract it ran under, the join key (bill_id), the master per field, and the counts matched, within tolerance, mismatched, orphaned and corrected, published every run including the all-clear
emits.readback: the report store returns a report_id, and reading that id back returns the contract id, the five counts and the published time; no id back means the run did not publish and the owner is told

emits.write: an exception on the bill naming the person who owns it: an open difference with the bank-feed value, the Xero value and the master's value side by side, an orphan (a bank line whose bill id is not in Xero, or a paid bill with no bank line), a difference over the threshold amount, a mismatch rate over the declared rate, or an accepted correction whose write returned no id
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the bill_id, the reason, both values and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
